query: SELECT ( COALESCE((SELECT SUM(db.size_bytes) FROM docker_blobs db WHERE db.digest IN ( SELECT dmb.blob_digest FROM docker_manifest_blobs dmb JOIN docker_manifests dm ON dm.id = dmb.manifest_id WHERE dm.package_repository_id = $1 UNION SELECT blob_digest FROM docker_repository_blobs WHERE package_repository_id = $1 )), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(octet_length(body)) FROM docker_manifests WHERE package_repository_id = $1), 0) + (SELECT count(*) FROM docker_tags WHERE package_repository_id = $1) * $2 )::BIGINT AS "total!"
